1.title: HOW TO PLAY
1.subtitle: Basic Controls
1.content: Master the art of word-weaving to defeat your foes.
bullets: Type words using letters on the wheel.

2.title: BATTLE MECHANICS
2.subtitle: Mana & Ultimate
2.content: Strategic use of your resources is key to survival.
bullets: Ultimate: Next word deals 2x damage at 100% gauge.
Mana: Regenerates slowly, used for special letters.
Shields: Absorb damage before your HP is touched.

3.title: SPECIAL LETTERS
3.subtitle: Elemental Effects
bullets: FIRE: Bonus damage (best as first letter).
HEAL: Restores HP based on word length.
